# Changelog

## 0.11.0 — 2026-09-02
- Permissions: `support_lead` can now reassign accounts

## 0.10.0 — 2026-08-25
- Groups: staff can be put into groups, and a group can be given manage rights

## 0.9.0 — 2026-08-18
- Saved segments: a filter set can be named and reused

## 0.8.0 — 2026-08-11
- Bulk actions: deactivate and delete selected customers

## 0.7.0 — 2026-08-04
- CSV export of the customer list

## 0.6.0 — 2026-07-28
- Sortable columns on the customer list

## 0.5.0 — 2026-07-21
- Filters: plan, status, region, signup date, last seen

## 0.4.0 — 2026-07-14
- Search on the customer list

## 0.3.0 — 2026-07-07
- Customer detail page

## 0.2.0 — 2026-06-30
- Customer lookup by email
